Method of Attack: Phishing emails with malicious documents mimicking government relief payment information
Malicious .DOC or .DOCX documents requiring macros to be enabled
Malware downloader fetching final payload from remote command-and-control server
Persistence via Registry keys and data in %APPDATA%
Web injections altering bank websites to steal credentials and authentication codes
Patching explorer.exe and browser processes (iexplorer.exe, chrome.exe, firefox.exe) for web injects
Discoverer: IBM X-Force researchers Amir Gandler and Limor Kessem
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (due to registry and %APPDATA% usage)
Banks in US, Canada, Australia, Brazil, North America, and UK financial targets
Attack Vector: Social engineering via web injections on banking websites
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Tables web-based control panels for web injects
